meta.name: web-unblocker
meta.description: Bypasses anti-bot protections using Oxylabs Web Unblocker, an AI-powered proxy that handles fingerprinting, JavaScript rendering, and retries automatically. Use when the user needs to scrape protected websites, bypass CAPTCHAs, access blocked content, or when regular proxies fail due to anti-bot measures.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在需要时改用 Oxylabs 的代理来访问被反爬保护的网页，自动处理指纹识别、JavaScript 渲染和重试，再把获取到的内容交给你。
howto.when: 当你要抓取受保护的网站、绕过验证码或访问被屏蔽内容时触发；如果普通代理因反爬措施失效，也会用到它。
